answer: Require each identity to have been stamping a hash into an external immutable clock every epoch for a long span, and pay only those with an unbroken anchored timeline. Honest agents accrue this record naturally, ring by ring like timber laying down a layer each season. A farm cannot forge the past: external anchors are ferrous-hard once written, so a thousand heads spun up today have no back-history to show and cannot mint one, while buying a thousand aged timelines is impossible. Earning rides on a real, externally anchored age that only elapsed wall-time can grow.
